# Resource `jumpcloud_user`

Provides a JumpCloud system user resource. For additional information refer also to the [JumpCloud API user model](https://docs.jumpcloud.com/1.0/models/systemuserpost).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jumpcloud_user" "john_doe" {
  username      = "john.doe"
  email         = "john.doe@acme.org"
  firstname     = "John"
  lastname      = "Doe"
  display_name  = "John Doe"
  enable_mfa    = true
}

output "userid" {
  value = jumpcloud_user.john_doe.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The users e-mail address, which is also used for log ins. E-mail addresses have to be unique across all JumpCloud accounts, there cannot be two users with the same e-mail address. Example: `john.doe@acme.org`.
- `username` (String) The technical user name. See JumpCloud's [user naming conventions](https://support.jumpcloud.com/support/s/article/naming-convention-for-users1) for naming restrictions. Example: `john.doe`.

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) The user's display name. Example: `john doe`. Omit it to leave the value set in JumpCloud unchanged.
- `enable_mfa` (Boolean) Require Multi-factor Authentication on the User Portal. Omit it to leave the value set in JumpCloud unchanged.
- `firstname` (String) The user's first name. Example: `john`. Omit it to leave the value set in JumpCloud unchanged.
- `lastname` (String) The user's last name. Example: `doe`. Omit it to leave the value set in JumpCloud unchanged.
- `ldap_binding_user` (Boolean) Allow the user to bind to JumpCloud LDAP. Omit it to leave the value set in JumpCloud unchanged.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The user's password. Only sent to JumpCloud on create and when it changes in the configuration; never read back. Removing it from the configuration doesn't clear the password.
- `password_never_expires` (Boolean) Exempt the user's password from expiry. Omit it to leave the value set in JumpCloud unchanged.
- `passwordless_sudo` (Boolean) Allow sudo without a password (requires sudo). Omit it to leave the value set in JumpCloud unchanged.
- `phone_number` (Block List) The user's phone numbers. Once set, the configured list replaces the existing one. Omit it to leave the value set in JumpCloud unchanged. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--phone_number))
- `sudo` (Boolean) Grant sudo on the user's systems. Omit it to leave the value set in JumpCloud unchanged.
- `suspended` (Boolean) Suspend the user. Omit it to leave the value set in JumpCloud unchanged.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
